ContentRef.description:
Where a large or sensitive body lives: `event_content.hash` (xxh3-128
hex) and its length. Retention may delete the body; the ref stays.

size.description: The whole body's length, stored or not.

truncated.description: Only the first part was stored (bodies are capped).

ToolDecision.description: What oxplow's agent policy said about a tool call.

description:
`agent.tool.requested@1`: the agent asked to run a tool (PreToolUse),
and whether the policy let it. Tool names are the canonical
(Claude-shaped) vocabulary every transport maps onto.

detail.description: A short summary (a truncated command, a search pattern).

path.description: Repo-relative path the tool targets, when it names one.

title: AgentToolRequestedV1
